name: Central Luzon rice farm
persona: Illustrative smallholder rice farmer, Nueva Ecija
place: Nueva Ecija province, Central Luzon, about 13 km south of the Science City of Munoz
story: Two irrigated rice crops a year leave a hot, dry gap from April to June (35 C+ in 29-30 of the last 30 years, driest soil in April). A short, heat-tolerant legume such as mungbean could fill it. Typhoons and heavy rain are a real risk (August 2026 rain was 2.6x normal).

name: Central Iowa corn-soybean farm
persona: Illustrative mechanized corn-soybean farmer, Boone County
place: Rural Boone County, Iowa, west of Ames
story: The classic two-crop rotation, mechanized and rain-fed. Fields sit bare from the October harvest to the May planting, through frost and snowmelt. A cereal rye cover crop could hold the soil over winter. A strong contrast with the Philippines farm.
